claude.sample_unit: synthetic acute-care cases (3 timepoints, 21 prompt variants, 3 runs, 3 models)

links.outcome: Output divergence under paraphrased/perturbed prompts and repeated runs across three local LLMs, with and without stability prompt
links.effect: Mean total JS distance ranged 0.126 to 0.306 across nine cells; STABLE cut it 27.2% for Gemma 3 12B (0.173 to 0.126) but only minimally for DeepSeek-R1 and gpt-oss; terminal top-action switching 0.253-0.584.
links.quote: Ordinary prompt variation was sufficient to produce measurable output divergence under both BASE and STABLE conditions, and management-action distributions were consistently more prompt-sensitive than diagnosis distributions.

links.outcome: Invalid structured-output rates and internal inconsistency between top action and probability argmax
links.effect: gpt-oss 20B invalid rate rose to 0.399 under STABLE at T3; DeepSeek-R1 reached 0.198 at T3; Gemma 3 12B had 0 invalid outputs but top-action argmax agreement fell to 0.389-0.397.
links.quote: gpt-oss 20B showed the opposite trade-off: among valid outputs, top-action argmax agreement remained very high, but invalid rates were substantial and rose to 0.399 under STABLE at the terminal timepoint.

links.outcome: Consistency between self-declared top action and returned action-probability vector
links.effect: Gemma 3 12B top-action argmax agreement deteriorated from about 0.87 at T1 to 0.389-0.397 at T3, whereas gpt-oss 20B stayed above 0.97 among valid outputs.
links.quote: Gemma 3 12B produced no invalid outputs in the primary analysis set, but its agreement between the self-declared top action and the argmax of action probabilities deteriorated over time, falling to 0.389-0.397 at the terminal timepoint.

unlisted_practices: Recompute top-label fields from returned probability vectors rather than trusting model-declared labels
Use pair-valid analysis rather than zero-filling invalid outputs when auditing LLM robustness
Report distributional stability and structured-output integrity as separate endpoints
Validate stability prompt layers separately for each model family
Trajectory-level multi-turn testing of prompt sensitivity
Use retry, fallback, or parser-repair pipelines for models with high invalid output rates

links.quote: At the terminal timepoint, top-1 action switching remained appreciable across all cells, ranging from 0.253 for Gemma 3 12B under STABLE to 0.584 for gpt-oss 20B under BASE.
